en.title: What Mechanism City found: saves, particle blending, painted textures, hover, sound and video
en.body: Fixes from the notes of Mechanism City, a 2D physics puzzle game. What `save.update` returns, and the data after an edit in place, must now pass `validate`: an arrow such as `data => (data.x = 1)` used to replace the whole save with `1`; it is now refused, nothing is written and `onProblem` hears `invalid`. A particle emitter takes `blendMode`, so sparks and fire can add up with `'add'`. A browser game gives `textureFromCanvas(canvas)` and `textureFromPixels(width, height, pixels)`, the lease of a texture painted in code in one step, and `createBrowserGame({ hover: true })` makes `game.hover` for a scroll control's wheel. `createWebAudioBackend` is exported, for a page that makes its mixer with `createAudioMixer`. `createBrowserVideo` takes a list in `src`, the first file the browser can play being played. The page on the browser game says the "No available adapters." line of `backend: 'auto'` comes from the browser itself.

zh.title: 《千机巧匠》发现的问题：存档、粒子混合、代码画的贴图、悬停、声音和视频
zh.body: 按 2D 物理解谜游戏《千机巧匠》的引擎笔记修正。`save.update` 返回的值、以及原地修改后的数据，现在都必须通过 `validate`：过去 `data => (data.x = 1)` 这样的箭头函数会把整个存档换成 `1`，现在会被拒绝，不写入，并以 `invalid` 报告给 `onProblem`。粒子发射器支持 `blendMode`，火花和火焰可以用 `'add'` 叠加变亮。浏览器游戏提供 `textureFromCanvas(canvas)` 和 `textureFromPixels(width, height, pixels)`，一步得到代码画出的贴图的租约；`createBrowserGame({ hover: true })` 会创建 `game.hover`，供滚动控件的滚轮使用。导出了 `createWebAudioBackend`，页面可以用 `createAudioMixer` 自建混音器。`createBrowserVideo` 的 `src` 可以是列表，播放浏览器能播的第一个文件。浏览器游戏的说明页写明了 `backend: 'auto'` 时那条 "No available adapters." 来自浏览器本身。
